note: Jump-only set: every question is appended after the end of the real attention session, so the previous answer is turn 18 and the expected parent is always an earlier answer. Categories: synonym = same meaning, different words; earlier = refers back to an earlier explanation; concept = asks about a specific term introduced elsewhere.
